Human video review confirmed that the teacher provided wait time and elicited multiple student responses before supplying the target textual detail. The evidence therefore does not sufficiently support treating additional wait time or partner recall as a meaningful missed pedagogical opportunity.

Evidence supports a minor missed opportunity to distinguish theme from central idea, but does not clearly support the broader claim that fact and supporting detail also required explicit clarification.
